review.approval_basis: The project owner approved q01-q08 and delegated q09-q15 plus a full consistency audit to Codex.
review.methodology: Five candidates per query: existing judgments, strict Boolean matches, then deterministic distinct-term overlap; relevance was assigned only after title-and-abstract review.
review.limitation: The pool is lexical and depth-5, not exhaustive; relevant documents outside the pool may remain unjudged.

consistency_audit_changes.reason: Although the population has obstructive sleep apnea, the study directly measures MOTS-c against BMI and insulin resistance, satisfying the query rather than merely providing background.
